## Purpose

This document verifies the cloud computing environment used for BU AD688 Assignment 01. It was generated on the assigned AWS Academy EC2 instance using Quarto and Python.

## System Information

```{python}
import platform
import sys
import psutil
from importlib.metadata import version

memory = psutil.virtual_memory()
disk = psutil.disk_usage("/")

system_info = {
    "Platform": "AWS EC2",
    "Operating system": platform.system(),
    "OS release": platform.release(),
    "OS version": platform.version(),
    "Machine architecture": platform.machine(),
    "Python version": sys.version.split()[0],
    "PySpark version": version("pyspark"),
    "psutil version": version("psutil"),
    "Logical CPU cores": psutil.cpu_count(logical=True),
    "Physical CPU cores": psutil.cpu_count(logical=False),
    "Total memory (GiB)": round(memory.total / (1024 ** 3), 2),
    "Available memory (GiB)": round(memory.available / (1024 ** 3), 2),
    "Root disk size (GiB)": round(disk.total / (1024 ** 3), 2),
    "Root disk free (GiB)": round(disk.free / (1024 ** 3), 2),
}

for component, value in system_info.items():
    print(f"{component}: {value}")
```

## Reproducibility

The report source is saved as `jianjie_system_info.qmd`. The Word document is rendered from this source with Quarto. Python dependencies are installed in a virtual environment on the EC2 instance.
